---
title: "Fixtures"
subtitle: "Twins: the same data in presentations that should draw identically"
---

The fixtures are storecard's test suite: each has a known, stated
presentation, so its card is known in advance. The tests build them from
small synthetic sources with the unchanged builders, and opt-in network tests
(`STORECARD_NETWORK=1 pytest`) check the published copies against the same
expectations.

Published catalog (public, CORS-enabled, range-readable):
<https://projects.pawsey.org.au/aad-derived/portolan-fixtures/catalog/catalog.json>.
F08 is not published yet.

The rest of this page is `portolan/README.md`; run its commands from
`portolan/`.
